description: This file defines a declarative configuration structure and associated functions for the 'Fischer' resource in Kubernetes, including methods for constructing, extracting, and modifying the configuration.

classes.name: FischerApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for the Fischer resource, including metadata and a list of disallowed flunders.

methods.name: Fischer
methods.description: Constructs a new FischerApplyConfiguration with specified name, kind, and API version.

methods.name: ExtractFischerFrom
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from a Fischer object, optionally for a subresource.

methods.name: ExtractFischer
methods.description: Extracts the applied configuration owned by a specific field manager from a Fischer object.

methods.name: IsApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Indicates that this is an apply configuration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the Kind field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the APIVersion field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the Name in the metadata.

methods.name: WithGenerateName
methods.description: Sets the GenerateName in the metadata.

methods.name: WithNamespace
methods.description: Sets the Namespace in the metadata.

methods.name: WithUID
methods.description: Sets the UID in the metadata.

methods.name: WithResourceVersion
methods.description: Sets the ResourceVersion in the metadata.

methods.name: WithGeneration
methods.description: Sets the Generation in the metadata.

methods.name: WithCreationTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the CreationTimestamp in the metadata.

methods.name: WithDeletionTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the DeletionTimestamp in the metadata.

methods.name: WithDeletionGracePeriodSeconds
methods.description: Sets the DeletionGracePeriodSeconds in the metadata.

methods.name: WithLabels
methods.description: Adds entries to the Labels map in the metadata.

methods.name: WithAnnotations
methods.description: Adds entries to the Annotations map in the metadata.

methods.name: WithOwnerReferences
methods.description: Adds owner references to the metadata.

methods.name: WithFinalizers
methods.description: Adds finalizers to the metadata.

methods.name: WithDisallowedFlunders
methods.description: Adds values to the DisallowedFlunders list.

methods.name: GetKind
methods.description: Retrieves the Kind value.

methods.name: GetAPIVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the APIVersion value.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Retrieves the Name value.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the Namespace value.
